events.body:
## Objective

Convert the existing coding harness into a production-quality coding agent that uses **Cloudflare Workers AI** as its LLM backend instead of the current provider.

The design should be modular so additional providers can be added later.

---

## Primary References

### Cloudflare Workers AI

Documentation

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/

Bindings

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/configuration/bindings/

Models

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/

OpenAI-compatible API

https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/configuration/open-ai-compatible-api/

---

### Cloudflare Agents SDK

https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/

GitHub

https://github.com/cloudflare/agents

Study the architecture but do not depend on this SDK unless it clearly simplifies the implementation.

---

### OpenCode

GitHub

https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode

Study:

* provider abstraction
* tool execution
* planning loop
* conversation management
* session persistence
* shell execution
* file editing

Use this as the primary architectural reference.

---

### OpenAI Codex (Open Source)

https://github.com/openai/codex

Study:

* coding workflow
* agent loop
* tool calling
* patch generation
* repository editing
* command execution

---

## Requirements

Implement a provider named:

CloudflareProvider

Responsibilities:

* chat completions
* streaming responses
* tool calling
* retry logic
* cancellation
* model selection
* configurable API endpoint
* configurable API token

Support models such as:

* Gemma
* Llama
* future Workers AI models

No model names should be hardcoded.

---

## Agent Architecture

Implement the following components.

Agent

Planner

Conversation

Memory

Session

ToolRegistry

CloudflareProvider

PromptBuilder

CommandExecutor

GitManager

FileEditor

SearchEngine

Each should be independently testable.

---

## Tool Calling

Support tools including:

* read_file
* write_file
* replace_text
* search_files
* grep
* list_directory
* execute_command
* git_status
* git_diff
* git_commit
* run_tests
* lint_project

Tools should use JSON schemas where appropriate and be extensible.

---

## Agent Loop

Implement the standard loop:

1. Receive user request.
2. Send conversation and available tools to Workers AI.
3. If the model requests a tool:

   * execute it
   * append the result to the conversation
   * continue.
4. Repeat until the model produces a final answer.
5. Stream intermediate reasoning only if explicitly enabled.

The loop should be reusable and independent of the UI.

---

## Memory

Implement:

* conversation history
* repository context
* project summary
* recently edited files
* token budgeting
* automatic summarization of long sessions

---

## Prompt Management

Separate:

system prompt

developer prompt

conversation

tool responses

Never concatenate prompts manually throughout the codebase.

---

## Editing

Support:

* whole file replacement
* patch-based edits
* multi-file edits
* preview before applying
* undo support

---

## Git Integration

Provide helpers for:

status

diff

commit

branch

stash

restore

The agent should use Git information when planning edits.

---

## Configuration

Allow configuration of:

* Cloudflare API token
* API endpoint
* model
* temperature
* max tokens
* timeout
* streaming
* retry count

No values should be compiled into the application.

---

## Code Quality

Use dependency injection where possible.

Avoid global state.

Write unit tests for all core components.

Document all public interfaces.

Use asynchronous networking.

Keep the provider isolated so additional providers can be added later.

---

## Deliverables

1. CloudflareProvider implementation.
2. Agent loop.
3. Tool execution framework.
4. Prompt management.
5. Memory management.
6. Streaming support.
7. Configuration system.
8. Tests.
9. Documentation.
10. Example demonstrating a complete coding session using Gemma on Cloudflare Workers AI.

The implementation should be production-ready, maintainable, and designed for future extension.
